label: POC Onboarding: Recent Errors
mcp_tool_description: Read the last minutes of a CloudBolt log (application by default; also jobengine, authentication, mcp, saml2) and return the WARNING-and-above entries grouped by exception and message, newest first, with tracebacks, secrets redacted, and a hint for each known pattern (failed handler verification, missing egress, proxy, SSL inspection, LDAP bind, missing image, subnet or key pair). Call it right after something failed in the UI: the resource handler form hides the real error but logs it under 'Failed to validate connection'. Use onb_log=jobengine for provisioning jobs and onb_contains to narrow by handler name or text. Only the last 8 MB of the file are read. Read-only; requires a CloudBolt admin caller.
